Video name: Which was the first state to approve the US Constitution?
column7: Delaware approved it on 7 December 1787, so it is called "The First State".

Video name: From which country did the USA buy Alaska in 1867?
column7: The USA paid $7.2 million for Alaska, about 2 cents per acre.

Video name: Whose face is on the US $100 bill?
column7: Benjamin Franklin was never President. He was a scientist, writer and founding father.

Video name: Which is the only US state whose name has just one syllable?
column7: Maine is also the only US state that borders just one other state: New Hampshire.

Video name: Which city was the first capital of the USA under the Constitution?
column7: George Washington took his oath as President at Federal Hall in New York City in 1789.

Video name: Which is the smallest US state by area?
column7: Despite its name, most of Rhode Island is on the mainland, not on an island.

Video name: Who wrote the first draft of the Declaration of Independence?
column7: Thomas Jefferson was only 33 years old when he wrote it in 1776.

Video name: Which US President was elected four times?
column7: The 22nd Amendment of 1951 now limits a President to two terms.

Video name: Yellowstone, the world's first national park, is mostly in which state?
column7: Yellowstone was set up in 1872. Small parts of it are in Montana and Idaho.

Video name: What is the tallest mountain in the USA?
column7: Denali in Alaska is about 6,190 m tall, the highest peak in North America.
